verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management SaaS whose AI Teammates coordinate tasks and workflows. Having an agent verify its own code implementation by driving an app UI and capturing before-and-after screenshots is a coding-agent or browser-automation axis, not something this kind of product ships. Nothing in the evidence shows Asana offers UI navigation or screenshot capture, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
